subject: Is it possible to display a wholehtml file within a Shiny App

messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: Is it possible to display a wholehtml file within a Shiny App
parts:
The recently released leafletR creates a web-map in the form of an HTML file held at a temporary location
such as 
C:\\Users\\...l\\Temp\\RtmpEtsA89/Fiji Earthquakes/Fiji Earthquakes.html"

The normal way of displaying it is via browseURL()

Is there anyways I can access this for a shiny app to make it interactive for users, and, if so
what would be appropriate ui.R and server.R code

cheers

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to display a wholehtml file within a Shiny App
parts:
You can rename/copy it to your app's www directory, then use an iframe to show it. Probably. :)

However, we are working on a Shiny binding for Leaflet that will be a more seamless fit, and let you react to map interactions using R code. See here for an example:
http://jcheng.shinyapps.io/superzip/
https://github.com/jcheng5/superzip

It's still far from feature complete though, and not really documented at all.
